claim: Produce a direct-T atomic spectrum with explicit H/He/metals and public atomic lines, retain EOS mismatch as a separate gate before coupling.
decision: A successful direct spectrum can replace temperature interpolation only within its declared atomic model. Do not declare it EOS-certified if ion/level populations, emission balance, line resolution or omitted components fail.
coverage: Request 100..1e7 Angstrom, use actual-state photon grid. Atomic line list completeness and F/Mg III/Ca III continuum must be disclosed; no fitted source scaling.
stop: Native run >120s or acquisition >120s stops. No stellar solve or grid expansion beyond these runs.
